content:
julia: Heads-up — mkdocs preview failed linkcheck on my branch (PR 4123). Errors point to anchors that include emoji and a hidden ZWJ/soft-hyphen in headings.
ryan: link?
julia: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/4123
julia: failing heading in file guides/release-notes.md:

    ### What's new — 2025​🎉

(just pasted from the file; note the invisible char between 2025 and 🎉)

sam: ah ye old zero-width space. mkdocs slugify produces different ids depending on environment.

docs-bot: linkcheck failed: /guides/release-notes/#whats-new-2025 - anchor not found

ryan: exact error from build?
julia: ```
WARNING - mkdocs.plugins.linkcheck - Broken link: /guides/release-notes/#whats-new-2025 (HTTP 404)
``` 
sam: probable fixes:
- normalize headings to remove ZW chars
- add explicit anchor ids: `### What's new — 2025 {#whats-new-2025}`
- update link targets to match slugify output

eli: can we script a fix? sed to remove \u200b and convert emoji to :shortcode:? we should be careful with translations.

sam: I'll open a tiny PR that strips ZW and backfills explicit IDs where linkcheck fails. also add a mkdocs linkcheck CI step to run with --strict on a sample locale.

julia: thanks — please cc me. I'll re-run preview after your PR.

sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/4130 - small script + patch

ejulia: looks good :thumbsup:

ryan: we should add a short note in the docs contribution guide about avoiding emoji in headers and using explicit IDs for stable links.

sam: will add a one-liner in CONTRIBUTING.md in follow-up PR.

julia: re-run preview passed. linkcheck green. :tada:
